title: finance.stock.adjusted, schema_version 1
description: Stock changed outside buying and selling, valued at what it cost: stock already on the shelf when the product started (opening: Dr inventory / Cr owner's equity), a count that found more or less than recorded (count), or stock destroyed (write_off). For count and write_off a loss is Dr stock losses / Cr inventory and a gain the reverse. Amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit; negative is stock lost.

reference.description: The product's own reference for the change (a disposal number, a movement id).

amount_minor.description: Signed total at cost: positive stock gained, negative stock lost. Equals the sum of the lines.
